sources.title: Schumann-anchored golden ratio organization of human neural oscillations
sources.readDepth: Selected full publisher HTML: abstract, §2.1.6 nulls, §2.1.7 power, §4.1 data, §6.8 limitations, §6.9 future work; not reproduced
sources.finding: Reports EEG spectral organization, explicitly lacks concurrent magnetometer measurements; no tested SR coupling or ET attribution. Fixed detection windows and parameterization sensitivity require independent audit.

sources.title: A Feasibility Study for Integrating Schumann Resonance Monitoring, Geomagnetic Activity Indices, and Large-Scale Ambulatory ECG Databases: Toward Synchronized Environmental–Physiological Research
sources.readDepth: Primary-publisher indexed abstract, highlights, §§2.9–2.10 and data-access statement. Direct HTML open returned429; whole paper and code not audited
sources.finding: Pipeline feasibility and illustrative simulation; physiological and SR datasets were not paired in time/place. Not empirical SR–HRV coupling. ALLSTAR requires controlled access.

sources.title: Transduction of the Geomagnetic Field as Evidenced from alpha-Band Activity in the Human Brain
sources.readDepth: Primary full-text selected abstract and Materials and Methods part1 (equipment, stimuli, blinding), not raw-data replay
sources.locator: Methods: experimental sequence and participant blinding
sources.finding: Reports EEG response to roughly35microtesla directional field rotations, with active/sham controls. Does not test picotesla Schumann drive, channeling or ET agency.

sources.title: Permutation inference for the general linear model
sources.readDepth: Primary full-text selected introduction, Theory/Model, p-values and Permutations/exchangeability
sources.locator: Introduction; Theory: p-values and Permutations and exchangeability
sources.finding: Null invariance/exchangeability determines allowed resampling; serial correlation defeats arbitrary pointwise shuffling. Paper does not itself solve our field-series null.

sources.title: Power-law dynamics in neuronal and behavioral data introduce spurious correlations
sources.readDepth: Primary abstract and author code-repository README only; PMC returned browser check and Wiley unavailable
sources.finding: Temporal dependence can inflate apparent brain/behavior associations; surrogate-code precedent exists. GPL2 code not copied or executed.

sources.title: Data-driven causal analysis of observational biological time series
sources.readDepth: Selected full-text abstract, introduction and Dependence/correlation/causality with authors constructed examples; not code replay
sources.finding: Observational causal methods depend on identifying assumptions; association and predictive information alone do not establish a directed intervention effect.

coverage: Bounded primary-source screen, not exhaustive SOTA ranking; no paired contact/SR dataset acquired.
